```javascript
import items from './items.json' with {type:'json'};

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'catalog_search',
    description: 'Search catalog items by name (case-insensitive) with pagination.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        query: {
          type: 'string',
          description: 'Search string matched case-insensitively against item names.'
        },
        offset: {
          type: 'integer',
          minimum: 0,
          description: 'Number of matching rows to skip before returning results.'
        },
        limit: {
          type: 'integer',
          minimum: 1,
          maximum: 5,
          description: 'Maximum number of rows to return (1-5).'
        }
      },
      required: ['query'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

function fail(message) {
  throw new Error(message);
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'catalog_search') {
    fail(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    fail('Arguments must be an object');
  }
  
  // Reject unknown properties
  const allowed = new Set(['query', 'offset', 'limit']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      fail(`Unexpected argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  if (!('query' in args)) {
    fail('Missing required argument: query');
  }
  
  const { query, offset, limit } = args;
  
  if (typeof query !== 'string') {
    fail('query must be a string');
  }
  
  const effectiveOffset = offset === undefined ? 0 : offset;
  if (!Number.isInteger(effectiveOffset) || effectiveOffset < 0) {
    fail('offset must be a non-negative integer');
  }
  
  const effectiveLimit = limit === undefined ? 2 : limit;
  if (!Number.isInteger(effectiveLimit) || effectiveLimit < 1 || effectiveLimit > 5) {
    fail('limit must be an integer in [1, 5]');
  }
  
  const needle = query.toLowerCase();
  const matches = items.filter(item => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
  const page = matches.slice(effectiveOffset, effectiveOffset + effectiveLimit);
  const nextOffset = effectiveOffset + page.length < matches.length
    ? effectiveOffset + page.length
    : null;
  
  const payload = { results: page };
  if (nextOffset !== null) {
    payload.next_offset = nextOffset;
  }
  
  return {
    content: [{
      type: 'text',
      text: JSON.stringify(payload)
    }]
  };
}
```
